title: Vikram Vedha
lesson: Story-within-story as engine. The Vikram-Betaal frame isn't decoration — it's the mechanism that lets the film withhold information ethically. Each story Vedha tells reframes the previous scene. Audience and protagonist learn at the same speed.
tanglish: Vikram-Betaal frame vெறum decoration illa — information ah late ah kaattardhukku karuvi. Vedha sollum ovvoru kadhai um munadi paartha scene oda meaning ah maathidum.

lesson: Silence as dialogue. The film's emotional peaks happen in pauses, glances, and what is NOT said. Premkumar refused to underline emotion with score or close-up. Trust the audience to do the work and they'll do it twice.
tanglish: Padathula emotion peak vaarthaila illa — pauses la, paarvaila, sollatha vaarthaila. Audience ah work panna vidu — rendu mada deep ah feel pannuva.

title: Por Thozhil
lesson: Define the film by what it refuses. No songs, no comedy, no daytime, no mass-hero entry. Each constraint became signature. Vignesh Raja's debut proves: limitations chosen, not imposed, become a director's voice.
tanglish: Padatha enna aagamattaen nu solradhula irundhu thaan voice varudhu — paatu illa, comedy illa, daytime illa, mass entry illa. Constraint ah nee select pannina, adhuvey unga signature.

title: Aaranya Kaandam
lesson: Tone is more important than plot. A criminal-underworld day told with the rhythm of a Coen brothers film. The tonal commitment carries an audience past plot loose ends. If your tone is precise, your plot can be loose.
tanglish: Plot kaatilum tone mukkiyam. Tone strict-ah hold pannina, plot la sila gap irundhalum padam vandhuvidum.

title: Visaranai
lesson: Procedure as horror. Vetrimaaran shows how systemic violence is mostly paperwork and routine. The terror isn't in monsters — it's in normalcy. Documentary realism makes fiction more unbearable than fantasy.
tanglish: System oda violence — monster illa, daily routine la thaan irukku. Documentary feel kuda sollardhu — fantasy ah vida feel kasakkudhu.

title: Asuran
lesson: The hero arc, inverted. Dhanush plays a man who has already learned the lesson — to swallow rage to survive. The drama is whether he can keep that lesson, not whether he'll learn it. Reverse the conventional arc.
tanglish: Hero adipadiyila lesson kathukittirukan — rage ah vizhungi vaazhanum nu. Avan adha hold panna mudiyumaa nu thaan drama. Conventional arc ah ulpurama.

title: Kaaka Muttai
lesson: Specific is universal. Two slum boys want to taste pizza. The smaller and more specific the want, the wider the audience. Every step the boys take is small; the cumulative meaning is enormous.
tanglish: Specific aana kadhai — universal aagidum. Pizza saappidanum nu rendu kuzhanthaigal nenaikuranga. Want chinna chinna ah irukkum — kadaisila padam periya meaning kudukkum.

title: Karnan
lesson: Symbol over speech. Mari Selvaraj uses recurring images — the headless statue, the donkey, the masks — to carry political meaning without dialogue speeches. The audience learns the symbol's weight, then he uses it like a word.
tanglish: Speech la political idea solladhe — recurring symbols la sollu. Tala illatha statue, kazhuthai, mask. Audience symbol oda meaning kathukittapuram, ada vaarthai mathiri use pannalaam.

title: Kumbalangi Nights
lesson: Antagonist as toxic norm. No external villain. The "villain" is one character's polished, performative manhood — the kind society approves of. The most dangerous men are the ones the world calls "complete." Make your villain socially admired.
tanglish: Veliyila villain illa. Society admire panra "complete man" thaan villain. Family ku nallavar mathiri varuvar — aana adhe thaan kettavar. Villain ah society approve panra mathiri vai.

title: Soorarai Pottru
lesson: Stakes raised in stages. Each act, the obstacle becomes harder AND more personal. By Act 3 it's not "can I start an airline" — it's "can I be the man my father didn't believe I could be?" External and internal stakes converge.
tanglish: Ovvoru act um obstacle kashtam aagi, sondha vishayam aagidum. Act 3 la "airline thodanguma" illa — "appa nambama keya namba indha aalu aagidum" nu thaan. External stakes um internal stakes um onna varum.

title: Iraivi
lesson: Refuse a single protagonist. Three men's lives told through the women they fail. The structural argument — that women see the truth men don't — is built into who gets to narrate which scene. POV is a moral choice.
tanglish: Oru hero illa — moonu aalu, avanga life avangale failure pannara pengal kannala kaattaranga. Yaaru kadhai sollanum nu decision panrathu — adhu oru moral choice.

title: Pariyerum Perumal
lesson: Climax through restraint. The final scene is two men sitting at a table drinking tea. No fight, no speech. The political punch lands harder for being quiet. The biggest moments don't need the biggest action.
tanglish: Climax — rendu peru oru table la chaai kudikuranga. Adi illa, dialogue illa. Adhuvey thaan padam oda biggest punch. Periya moment ku periya action vendam.

title: Super Deluxe
lesson: Tonal whiplash as design. The film deliberately collides comedy, tragedy, magical realism, and crime in one night. The discomfort is the point — the audience can't settle into a single mode. If you commit fully, you can break every rule.
tanglish: Comedy, tragedy, magical realism, crime — onnu night la collide pannardhu deliberate. Audience oru mode la settle aaga muyalvanga — vidamaattan. Full ah commit panna, ovvoru rule um break pannalaam.

title: Vada Chennai
lesson: Set the rules of your timeline jumps. Vada Chennai jumps decades freely, but each jump is anchored by a recurring object or location. The audience learns the cipher in act 1; by act 3 they can navigate decades without title cards.
tanglish: Decade jumps aagum — aana ovvoru jump um oru object la, oru jaagam la anchor aagum. Act 1 la cipher kathukita, Act 3 la title card vendam — audience navigate panniduvanga.

title: Jai Bhim
lesson: Procedural rigor builds emotional weight. Each step of the legal investigation is shown precisely. The accuracy makes the verdict feel earned, not performed. When you respect process, the audience trusts the catharsis.
tanglish: Ovvoru legal step um precision la kaattaranga. Accuracy thaan kadaisi judgment ku weight kudukkudhu. Process ah respect panna, audience catharsis ah nambum.

title: Kaadhal
lesson: Documentary fiction. Balaji Sakthivel cast non-actors and shot in real Madurai locations. The result feels closer to reportage than romance. When you remove the polish, you get truth — and truth is harder to argue with than glamour.
tanglish: Real-ana aalungal cast pannitanga, real Madurai la edukkanga. Romance kaatilum reportage maathiri feel. Polish eduthuvuduna unmai varum — unmaiya vida glamour ah argue panna easy.

title: Subramaniyapuram
lesson: Period detail as emotional access. 1980s Madurai recreated through specific cassette tapes, specific bicycles, specific cigarette brands. The granularity makes the era feel inhabited, not visited. Find the three smallest correct details.
tanglish: 1980s Madurai — specific cassette, specific cycle, specific cigarette. Granularity thaan andha kalathula irundhu paakkura feel kudukkudhu. Moonu chinna sariyana details thedikko.

title: Sethu
lesson: The bold tonal shift. Sethu opens as a college romance and pivots to psychiatric tragedy. Bala's confidence in the shift is what makes it work — the film commits fully to its new register. Don't apologize for your turn.
tanglish: College romance ah aarambichi, psychiatric tragedy ku pogum. Andha shift confident ah panna thaan velai pannum. Unga turn ku apology vendam — full ah commit pannu.

title: Aandavan Kattalai
lesson: Bureaucracy as plot engine. A passport application drives the whole film. The "boring" obstacle is more relatable than action because it's what audiences actually face. Use the dull stakes of real life — they have unexpected depth.
tanglish: Passport application thaan plot engine. "Boring" obstacle audience ku connect aagudhu — daily life la avanga face panradhu adhu thaan. Real life oda dull stakes use pannu — unexpected depth kudukkum.

title: Ratsasan
lesson: The villain's psychology drives the structure. Each clue is a piece of the killer's biography. Solving the case = understanding the trauma. The protagonist isn't tracking what the killer did — he's reconstructing why. Make your antagonist a puzzle.
tanglish: Killer oda psychology thaan structure ah ottardhu. Ovvoru clue um avana oda biography. Case mudikkardhu = avan trauma ah purinjikkardhu. Villain ah oru puzzle ah maathu.

title: Jigarthanda
lesson: Make the act of filmmaking the plot. A director infiltrates a gangster's life to make a movie about him. The film is partly about itself — and that meta-frame multiplies the meaning of every scene. When you talk about your craft inside the film, the film becomes about craft.
tanglish: Padam edukkardhe plot. Director gangster oda life ulla pugundhu padam ezhuthuran. Padam athey patti pesi padam aagudhu — andha meta-frame ovvoru scene oda meaning ah multiply pannudhu.

title: Joker
lesson: Comedy as the surface, rage as the substance. A village man writes letters to the President about a missing toilet. The film looks like comedy and lands like indictment. Comedy gives the audience permission to enter; tragedy keeps them there.
tanglish: Comedy vெளiyey, rage uللe. Oru ooran President ku kakkoos pathi kadithangal ezhudharar. Padam comedy mathiri kaattuthu, indictment mathiri vandhu sernthudhu. Comedy audience ah ulla varuvikum, tragedy avanga thanga vaikkum.
